claims: Continue broad-spectrum empiric antibiotics (cefepime and vancomycin) while awaiting culture results, given leukocytosis and clinical status.
Monitor for hyperkalemia and renal function while continuing potassium chloride replacement.
Repeat CBC with differential to trend leukocytosis (WBC 41.1 to 21.3 K/uL) and assess response to therapy.
Repeat basic metabolic panel to reassess anion gap, bicarbonate, and electrolytes.
Continue anticoagulation with apixaban, monitoring for bleeding given supratherapeutic INR and thrombocytopenia trend.
Monitor coagulation studies (PT/INR, PTT) given elevated INR 2.1.
Maintain continuous cardiac and pulse oximetry monitoring with alarms for tachycardia and desaturation.
Continue bronchodilator therapy with ipratropium-albuterol nebulizers and albuterol inhaler for respiratory support.
Encourage incentive spirometry and deep breathing exercises to prevent atelectasis.
Reassess volume status and blood pressure (recent mean 55-62 mmHg) with continued IV fluid administration as ordered.
